purpose: Machine-readable landing work packages for the 12 controllable-flux motor schemes. These packages turn review findings into executable engineering next steps without claiming engineering validation.
global_constraints: passed_numeric_simulation means reproducible numeric/proxy simulation only
engineering_validated remains false until FEA, HIL, bench, thermal, EMC, insulation, safety, and hardware evidence exist
safety limits override torque and efficiency objectives
all generated artifacts must be traceable from coverage JSON, experiment summary, tests, and human-readable docs

work_packages.title: Repair simulation coverage evidence chain
work_packages.rationale: models/scheme_simulation_coverage.json currently references tests/test_control_search.py, which is not present in tests/.
deliverables: models/scheme_simulation_coverage.json uses only existing pytest test paths
tests/test_scheme_simulation_coverage.py asserts every pytest_tests path exists
acceptance_criteria: python -m pytest tests/test_scheme_simulation_coverage.py -q passes
all pytest_tests paths in coverage JSON exist on disk
completion_evidence: models/scheme_simulation_coverage.json now references tests/test_exp_001_runner.py for mtpa_fw_mtpv_control
tests/test_scheme_simulation_coverage.py now checks pytest_tests path existence

work_packages.title: Synchronize Claude docs with EXP-001 through EXP-010 current status
work_packages.rationale: claude-docs README, handoff, manifest, wiki evidence, and HTML evidence lag behind current simulation coverage.
acceptance_criteria: EXP-001 through EXP-010 are represented consistently
every represented proxy result still states the engineering validation limitation

work_packages.title: Update wiki and HTML experiment matrices
work_packages.rationale: The active wiki and HTML knowledge base still use stale experiment numbering and omit current EXP-005 through EXP-010 status.
deliverables: wiki/controllable_flux_motor_research_plan.md has an EXP-001 through EXP-010 status table
controllable_flux_motor_kb.html has matching EXP-001 through EXP-010 cards
acceptance_criteria: HTML and wiki do not contradict models/scheme_simulation_coverage.json
manifest references refreshed snapshots

work_packages.title: Create safety-aware control LUT foundation
work_packages.rationale: The short-term landing path must connect field weakening, MTPA/FW/MTPV search, and thermal/demag safety limits before any bench work.
acceptance_criteria: control LUT marks infeasible regions
candidate search respects current, voltage, thermal, and demag constraints
mode transitions have bounded id/iq and torque discontinuity

work_packages.title: Connect nonlinear flux LUT to shared voltage-constrained search
work_packages.rationale: EXP-006 currently proves synthetic LUT interpolation and nonlinear torque, but not a committed shared search/control trajectory integration.
deliverables: sim/search.py supports optional nonlinear flux LUT without breaking linear baseline
tests for linear baseline regression and LUT path behavior
acceptance_criteria: EXP-001 linear summary regression remains unchanged
LUT search refuses or clips out-of-bounds points explicitly
LUT search CSV schema remains compatible with EXP-001 scan schema

work_packages.title: Replace modulation proxy penalties with measurable limits
work_packages.rationale: EXP-005 uses parametric THD, inverter loss, and torque ripple penalties that must be replaced before controller enablement.
deliverables: PWM reconstruction or THD estimation script
acceptance_criteria: each k_mod candidate has a documented speed/load/Vdc enable region
THD, torque ripple, inverter loss, and NVH risk are bounded
overmodulation falls back to linear SVPWM outside allowed region

work_packages.title: Define FEA candidate and LUT backfeed contract
work_packages.rationale: EXP-003 uses scaled Ld/Lq/psi_f proxies; landing requires FEA-derived lambda_d/lambda_q candidate maps and scorecards.
deliverables: PM fraction and saliency sweep plan
acceptance_criteria: candidate variables have units, bounds, and constraints
FEA LUT data can be consumed by the nonlinear LUT schema
scorecard includes torque, voltage margin, iron loss, demag, rotor stress, and torque ripple risk

work_packages.title: Add state confidence and pulse-energy model for memory motor route
work_packages.rationale: EXP-002 proves that simple psi_f reduction is not automatically beneficial; real memory-motor landing depends on state observability and safe pulse energy.
deliverables: state confidence and unknown-state derating model
acceptance_criteria: unknown flux state derates torque safely
pulse current and energy stay within inverter, DC-link, thermal, and demag limits
route has explicit go/no-go business case

work_packages.title: Upgrade hybrid excitation from equivalent psi shift to field circuit model
work_packages.rationale: EXP-007 only models steady-state equivalent flux and field copper loss; landing requires field dynamics, thermal coupling, and fault handling.
acceptance_criteria: field current command respects thermal and electrical limits
weighted total loss beats control-only weak-field baseline before hardware trade study
loss-of-field and over-excitation fault modes have safe derates

work_packages.title: Convert winding reconfiguration proxy into switch-state and transient model
work_packages.rationale: EXP-008 uses parametric winding scaling and continuity proxy; hardware landing depends on legal states, switching transients, interlocks, and failure handling.
deliverables: stuck-switch and illegal configuration fault table
acceptance_criteria: all legal and illegal configurations are enumerated
switching only occurs inside a documented safe current/voltage window
benefit exceeds switch matrix loss, cost, reliability, and EMI risk

work_packages.title: Establish multiphase use case and resource budget before hardware study
work_packages.rationale: EXP-009 uses aggregate current derating; landing requires a product reason for multiphase plus harmonic subspace, thermal, and controller resource models.
deliverables: harmonic subspace or neutral-shift model plan
MCU/FPGA PWM and ADC resource budget
acceptance_criteria: route has a product-level fault tolerance or thermal/NVH value proposition
controller and gate-driver resources fit the target control period
phase-loss behavior is represented beyond aggregate current derating

work_packages.title: Upgrade Pareto scorecard beyond illustrative copper loss
work_packages.rationale: EXP-010 ranks candidates using illustrative drive cycles and copper loss only; route promotion requires broader and traceable scoring.
deliverables: loss model extension plan for copper, iron, inverter, mechanical losses
representative or measured drive-cycle input format
acceptance_criteria: scorecard traces every score to artifacts
risk, cost, maturity, safety, and evidence level are included
ranking sensitivity to drive-cycle weights is reported

work_packages.title: Promote thermal and demag safety to mandatory cross-cutting gate
work_packages.rationale: EXP-004 uses simplified thermal/demag boundaries; all landing routes require a stronger safety layer before bench or high-voltage work.
acceptance_criteria: optimization cannot override safety limits
thermal, current, voltage, and demag constraints can be applied during candidate search
fault cases choose derating or shutdown over torque tracking
